articles.title: Trump posta meme con Meloni, 'necessaria ordinanza restrittiva'
articles.summary: Donald Trump posted a meme featuring Meloni with a caption suggesting a restraining order is needed.

articles.title: Meloni, 'Italia al top del turismo in Europa, grande lavoro del comparto'
articles.summary: Meloni stated that Italy continues to lead in European tourism for summer 2026 and committed the government to supporting the sector.

articles.title: Meloni al congresso Uil, prove d'intesa dai salari all'IA
articles.summary: Meloni addressed the Uil union congress in Padova, confirming government commitment to tax-free contractual wage increases and pledging zero tolerance against labor trafficking.

articles.title: Meloni, il futuro dell'Italia è delle donne lavoratrici, resta la priorità
articles.summary: Meloni stated at the Uil congress that women workers are crucial to Italy's future and highlighted the achievement of record female employment rates.

articles.title: Meloni, Italia più solida e credibile, anche l'occupazione lo testimonia
articles.summary: Meloni told Federmanager that Italy demonstrates greater stability and credibility through employment metrics including record occupation rates and historic low unemployment.
